children.name: Psammophis leithii
children.description: Psammophis leithii, commonly called Leith's sand snake, the Pakistani ribbon snake, and the Pakistan sand racer, is a species of rear-fanged, mildly venomous snake in the family Psammophiidae.

children.name: Psammophis sudanensis
children.description: Psammophis sudanensis, commonly known as the northern stripe-bellied sand snake or Sudanese sand snake, is a fast-moving, slender, and diurnal snake species found in East and Central African savannas.

children.name: Psammophis leightoni
children.description: Psammophis leightoni, also called commonly the Cape sand racer, Cape sand snake, fork-marked sand snake, and Namib sand snake, is a species of mildly venomous snake in the family Psammophiidae.

children.name: Psammophis rukwae
children.description: Psammophis rukwae, commonly known as the Lake Rukwa sand snake or Rukwa sand racer, is a species of slender, fast-moving diurnal snakes belonging to the family Psammophiidae.

children.name: Psammophis indochinensis
children.description: Psammophis indochinensis, also known as the Indo-Chinese sand snake, is a species of snake in the family Psammophiidae.

children.name: Psammophis crucifer
children.description: Psammophis crucifer, the cross-marked grass snake or the cross-marked sand snake and Montane grass snake, is a species of mildly venomous snake belonging to the genus Psammophis.

children.name: Psammophis phillipsii
children.description: Psammophis phillipsii, also known by its common name olive grass racer, is a species from the genus Psammophis.

children.name: Psammophis pulcher
children.description: Psammophis pulcher, commonly known as the beautiful sand snake or Boulenger's sand racer, is a highly elusive, small, and slender diurnal colubrid found in East Africa.

children.name: Psammophis angolensis
children.description: Psammophis angolensis, sometimes known as the dwarf sand snake, is a species of snake in the family Psammophiidae reaching a maximum length of 50 cm, but averaging 30 cm.

children.name: Psammophis biseriatus
children.description: Psammophis biseriatus, commonly known as the link-marked sand snake or two-striped sand racer, is a slender, swift, and mildly venomous colubrid snake found in the dry thornbush and arid regions of East Africa and the Horn of Africa.

children.name: Psammophis aegyptius
children.description: Psammophis aegyptius, commonly known as the Saharan sand snake or Egyptian sand snake, is a species of highly agile, diurnal reptiles belonging to the family Psammophiidae.

children.name: Psammophis condanarus
children.description: Psammophis condanarus, the sand snake, is a species of snake found in dry low country zones of Indian peninsula (except the far south), Pakistan and Nepal.

children.name: Psammophis sibilans
children.description: Psammophis sibilans, commonly known as the hissing sand snake or Egyptian hissing sand snake, is a snake from the family Psammophiidae.

children.name: Psammophis praeornatus
children.description: Psammophis praeornatus, also known as the Ornate Olympic Snake, is a species of colubrid snake.

children.name: Psammophis subtaeniatus
children.description: Psammophis subtaeniatus, the western yellow-bellied sand snake, is a snake found in northern Southern Africa; more specifically the north of KwaZulu-Natal and further north to Mozambique, Zimbabwe, Gauteng, North West, Limpopo, and Eswatini.

children.name: Psammophis mossambicus
children.description: Psammophis mossambicus, the olive grass snake, is a snake species in the family Psammophiidae, the sand and whip snakes (not to be confused with the Australian olive whipsnake, Demansia olivacea).

children.name: Psammophis punctulatus
children.description: Psammophis punctulatus, commonly known as the speckled sand snake or speckled sand racer, is a species of snake in the family Psammophiidae.

children.name: Psammophis longifrons
children.description: Psammophis longifrons, the stout sand snake or long sand racer, is a species of snake found in India.

children.name: Psammophis leopardinus
children.description: Psammophis leopardinus, commonly known as the leopard sand snake or leopard whip snake, is a slender, mildly venomous colubrid snake found in southern Africa (particularly Namibia, Botswana, and South Africa).

children.name: Psammophis lineolatus
children.description: Psammophis lineolatus, commonly known as steppe ribbon racer or arrow snake, is a species of mildly venomous snake (not harmful to humans) in the family Lamprophiidae.

children.name: Psammophis jallae
children.description: Psammophis jallae, commonly known as Jalla's sand snake, is a slender, strictly diurnal, and mildly venomous snake endemic to arid savannas in southern Africa.

children.name: Psammophis notostictus
children.description: Psammophis notostictus, the Karoo sand snake or the Karoo whip snake, is a species of mildly venomous snake belonging to the genus Psammophis.

children.name: Psammophis trigrammus
children.description: Psammophis trigrammus, the western sand snake, is a diurnal, terrestrial snake in the family Psammophiidae from southwestern Africa.

children.name: Malpolon monspessulanus
children.description: Malpolon monspessulanus, commonly known as the Montpellier snake, is a species of mildly venomous rear-fanged snake.

children.name: Mimophis occultus
children.authorship: Ruane, Myers, Lo, Yuen, Welt, Juman, Futterman, Nussbaum, Schneider, Burbrink & Raxworthy, 2017

children.name: Psammophylax rhombeatus
children.description: Psammophylax rhombeatus is a reptile commonly found throughout Southern Africa.

children.name: Rhamphiophis oxyrhynchus
children.description: Rhamphiophis oxyrhynchus is a species of mildly venomous snake in the family Psammophiidae.

children.name: Rhamphiophis rostratus
children.description: Rhamphiophis rostratus, commonly known as the rufous beaked snake, is a species of snake in the family Psammophiidae.
